yes.0: Have you heard of the Spirit Diviner? It's a title for people who can hear the voices of sad spirits roaming among us. You could be one of them too. All you have to do is eliminate #bPlatoon Chronos, Master Chronos, Mummydogs, and Wraiths#k to help them get to their afterlife. Then you could be a Spirit Diviner!
